name: OpenMBEE Flexo / MMS
description: Open-source model repository and API infrastructure for collaborative MBSE, including a graph-native MMS store and an implementation of the OMG SysML v2 API Services specification.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. This record covers repository and service infrastructure rather than treating Flexo / MMS as an ordinary modeling editor.

collaboration.note: OpenMBEE describes the platform as an open-source collaborative engineering system.

sysmlV2Api.note: Flexo SysMLv2 is an implementation of the OMG SysML v2 API Services specification.

classificationNotes: This record is for repository and API infrastructure. OpenMBEE's separate SysML v2 Web Modeler is not treated as the same product.
OpenMBEE prefers Apache-2.0 across its projects, but no single SPDX identifier is asserted here for every component.
